purpose: Teach: ドナー/太陽系/火薬/油田

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、臓器ドナー詐欺の捜査を、警察、進められますね
lines.en: So for this case, the police are moving ahead with the organ donor fraud investigation, right?
lines.style: Earnest, slightly over-precise delivery, careful pacing, a respectful questioning rise at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、天文台への侵入事案、つまり太陽系研究施設の捜査もされますね
lines.en: The police are also investigating the observatory break-in — the solar system research facility, that is.
lines.style: Measured official cadence, calm and even, clarifying emphasis when restating the facility.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、火薬類の不法所持の捜査を、警察、徹底されますね
lines.en: And for this case, the police will be thorough in investigating the illegal possession of gunpowder, right?
lines.style: Leaning-in seriousness, deliberate stress on the word 'thorough', voice steady but keen.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、油田、つまり海外油田での日本人事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police also handle cases involving Japanese nationals at oil fields — overseas oil fields, that is.
lines.style: Unruffled professional tone, even pace, a faint note of quiet capability.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、ドナー、つまりドナーカード偽造を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: And this case — the donor card forgeries, I mean — the police are investigating that too, right?
lines.style: Curious and precise, small self-correcting pause mid-line, ending on an expectant rise.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、火薬の押収量も、警察、慎重に管理されますね
lines.en: And the police manage the quantities of seized gunpowder very carefully as well.
lines.style: Calm concluding tone, unhurried, quiet reassurance settling on the final word.
